description: Header file defining classes and functions for managing undo actions in the map editor of the Wesnoth game, including undo/redo stacks, action details, and related operations.

classes.name: map_undo_action
classes.description: Represents a single undoable action in the map editor, storing terrain changes, selections, map data, and starting locations.

methods.name: map_undo_action
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new undo action.

methods.name: undo_terrains
methods.description: Returns the terrain states before the action.

methods.name: redo_terrains
methods.description: Returns the terrain states after the action.

methods.name: undo_selection
methods.description: Returns the selection state before the action.

methods.name: redo_selection
methods.description: Returns the selection state after the action.

methods.name: new_map_data
methods.description: Returns the map data after the action.

methods.name: old_map_data
methods.description: Returns the map data before the action.

methods.name: undo_starting_locations
methods.description: Returns starting locations before the action.

methods.name: redo_starting_locations
methods.description: Returns starting locations after the action.

methods.name: add_terrain
methods.description: Records a terrain change in the undo action.

methods.name: terrain_set
methods.description: Checks if terrain change has been recorded.

methods.name: set_selection
methods.description: Records a selection change in the undo action.

methods.name: selection_set
methods.description: Checks if selection change has been recorded.

methods.name: set_map_data
methods.description: Records a map data change.

methods.name: map_data_set
methods.description: Checks if map data change has been recorded.

methods.name: add_starting_location
methods.description: Records a change in starting location.

methods.name: starting_location_set
methods.description: Checks if starting location change has been recorded.

methods.name: add_undo_action
methods.description: Adds an undo action to the undo stack.

methods.name: exist_undo_actions
methods.description: Checks if there are undo actions available.

methods.name: exist_redo_actions
methods.description: Checks if there are redo actions available.

methods.name: pop_undo_action
methods.description: Undoes the last action and moves it to the redo stack.

methods.name: pop_redo_action
methods.description: Redoes the last undone action.

methods.name: clear_undo_actions
methods.description: Clears all undo/redo history.
